changes.quote: KBB used in AZ, CA, CO, ID, NM, NV, OR, UT, WA, WY. All other states, use JD Power.
changes.note: GLS had no valuation rows at all — only an EV allow-list and an ineligible list. Texas is not in the KBB group, so TX books on J.D. Power clean trade. The current-year-used rule is the unusual one worth having on the page: invoice required, then 90% of invoice less $0.25 per mile and less all rebates and incentives.

ambiguities.note: Record stores "2026 (v53)". Confirmed: the sheet has no date anywhere, only the footer GLS_PG_V53_2026. The filename says 072726. This is why gls sits in acknowledged.json — the divergence is the document's fault, not the record's. Consider storing "July 27, 2026 (v53)" so freshness can read it, but that is a judgement call about trusting a filename.

Record says "Photocopy of valid U.S. driver's license required for all signers." Neither page says that; p2 lists a driver's license only as one of the two-document residence options. Possibly from the separate Funding Guidelines PDF. Unverified here.
Record says "Primarily Equifax." Neither page mentions bureaus.
